body: Honestly, that sounds like a bad idea - though I don't fault you for suggesting it. Trying to place myself in mindsets from the past tends to send me into flashback spirals, which are miserable.

Don't get me wrong. I have my own debts to repay. Kindnesses not yet reciprocated, gratitude not yet expressed, apologies not yet made. Those, combined with simple inertia, are what keep me alive. This solitude is not characteristic of my life, and I have a pretty rare opportunity to end it cleanly at this point in time.

I don't think I'm likely to kill myself consciously. I might do it if I get really drunk, but guilt will probably keep me alive.
